decisions_log.decision: listEntries() return type narrowed to `(ChangelogEntry & { breaking: boolean })[]`
decisions_log.rationale: The spec requires every response entry to carry breaking as a boolean. Expressing this in the return type catches any call site that forgets the normalisation step, rather than relying on a runtime cast.

decisions_log.decision: Breaking normalisation uses strict equality `entry.breaking === true`
decisions_log.rationale: The SWE constraint explicitly requires `entry.breaking === true` rather than truthy coercion to prevent `1`, `'true'`, or other values being treated as breaking if source data drifts.

The spec says 'any value other than the exact string true' is a 400. The analyst noted this was unsettled, but the year-param pattern (reject anything that does not match the expected shape) is the binding convention, and the security constraint is explicit: reject rather than silently coerce.

decisions_log.decision: Existing handler test for GET /entries updated to not use deepEqual on full entries
decisions_log.rationale: listEntries() now normalises entries by adding a boolean breaking field, so the returned objects are no longer reference-equal to the input fixtures. The test was changed to assert count and title fields, which is what the test actually cares about.

files_changed.summary: Added `breaking?: boolean` to ChangelogEntry type and EntryQuery type. listEntries() now normalises breaking to a boolean (false when absent via `entry.breaking === true`) and filters entries when query.breaking is true. Return type is narrowed to `(ChangelogEntry & { breaking: boolean })[]`.

Parses `?breaking=` query parameter. Accepts the exact string 'true' (passes `breaking: true` to listEntries); rejects any other non-null value with 400. Absence of the parameter passes `breaking: undefined` (no filter).

Added breakingSample fixture and five new tests covering AC7, AC8, AC11: breaking filter returns only breaking entries; absent field excluded; entries without the field normalised to false; empty list on no matches.

Updated entries fixture to include a breaking entry. Added six new tests covering AC7, AC8, AC9, AC11: ?breaking=true filter; 200+empty on no matches; boolean field on every response entry; 400 for false/1/yes/empty string values.

self_assessment.notes: All 21 tests pass (npm test). The 7 acceptance criteria in scope for this repository (AC7, AC8, AC9, AC11 + AC10 by omission) are covered. AC1-AC6 and AC12 belong to pixie-sandbox/pixie-sandbox-site and are not addressed here per task scope. No new dependencies introduced. Only erasable TypeScript syntax used. Local imports use .ts extension. breaking normalisation uses strict equality === true as required.
